# Bridgewell Advisory

> Bridgewell Advisory is India's specialist recruitment advisory and executive search firm — a strategic hiring partner for founders, CXOs, and leadership teams. We focus on mid-to-senior leadership hiring (Managers, Heads, Directors, VPs, and CXOs) and fix the hiring decision before the search begins, rather than operating as a volume recruitment agency.

Bridgewell Advisory is led personally by Shakkir KP (SHRM-CP), founder and principal advisor. Every mandate — intake, role diagnosis, calibration, shortlist, and close — is run by the principal, not delegated to junior recruiters. The firm serves startups and growth-stage companies across IT, Digital, E-Commerce, FMCG, and Renewable Energy sectors in India, with primary presence in Bengaluru.

## What Bridgewell Advisory Does

- [Executive & Senior Search](https://bridgewell-advisory.in/#services): Director, VP, and CxO mandates run with advisory rigour — business context first, candidates second. Fewer, sharper-fit profiles instead of high-volume sourcing.
- [Strategic HR Advisory](https://bridgewell-advisory.in/#approach): Workforce planning, role design, offer structuring, and organisational calibration — fixing the hiring decision, not just filling a vacancy.
- [AI-Augmented Assessment](https://bridgewell-advisory.in/#approach): Structured, AI-supported evaluation at intake and shortlist stages, with final judgement made by a senior practitioner.

## Key Facts

- Specialisation: Mid-to-senior leadership hiring — Managers, Leads, Heads, Directors, VPs, CXOs
- Sectors: IT, Digital, E-Commerce, FMCG, Renewable Energy
- Geography: India-wide; based in Bengaluru, Karnataka
- Engagement models: Pilot, Partnership, and Advisory
- Fee range: ₹5L to ₹25L depending on role complexity and engagement structure
- Leadership: Every engagement personally led by Shakkir KP, SHRM-CP (Founder & Principal Advisor)
- Positioning: Strategic hiring partner, explicitly not a volume recruitment agency

## Frequently Asked Questions

- What is recruitment advisory in India?: Recruitment advisory helps companies define hiring strategy, improve role clarity, and close positions faster with better-quality hires — distinct from contingency recruitment.
- How is Bridgewell different from recruitment agencies?: Bridgewell works as a strategic hiring partner focused on problem diagnosis and role clarity before search begins, unlike agencies that only source candidates against a brief.
- What roles do you specialise in?: Mid-to-senior hiring including Managers, Leads, Heads, Directors, VPs, and CXO-level roles across India.
- Who do you work with?: Startups, founders, CXOs, and growing companies that need a strategic partner for critical, business-defining hires.
- Who leads engagements?: Every mandate is personally led by Shakkir KP, SHRM-CP, founder and principal advisor.
- How does Bridgewell charge?: Pilot, partnership, and advisory models, with fees typically ranging from ₹5L to ₹25L depending on role complexity and engagement structure.
